brand.name: Vela Trattoria
brand.descriptor: A wood-fired Italian kitchen in Seattle's Fremont neighborhood: handmade pasta, a short natural wine list and a nightly changing oven special.

text.heading: Handmade pasta and a wood-fired oven, six nights a week
text.body: We roll pasta every morning and keep the oven running until close. Stop by the bar for a plate or book ahead for a full table.

text.heading: Menu highlights
text.intro: A short seasonal menu built around what the market and the wood oven give us that day.

items.name: Cacio e pepe
items.description: Fresh tonnarelli, Pecorino Romano, cracked black pepper.

items.name: Wood-fired margherita
items.description: San Marzano tomato, fior di latte, basil, olive oil.

items.name: Braised short rib pappardelle
items.description: Slow-braised beef, red wine, pappardelle, gremolata.

items.name: Affogato
items.description: Vanilla gelato, hot espresso, cocoa nib.

text.heading: Book a table
text.body: We hold half the dining room for walk-ins, but a booking guarantees your table on a Friday or Saturday night.

text.heading: Our story
text.body: Chef Marco Belline opened Vela Trattoria in 2019 after a decade cooking in Bologna and Seattle kitchens. The menu changes with the season, but the wood oven never goes cold.

items.caption: The wood-fired oven
items.blurb: Burning apple and oak all night.

items.caption: The pasta bar
items.blurb: Tonnarelli and pappardelle, rolled fresh each morning.

items.caption: The dining room
items.blurb: Twelve tables and six seats at the bar.

items.title: Best pasta in Fremont

items.title: A wonderful date-night spot
